newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish shares close higher with U.S. and Nokia.
newsitem.headline: Finnish shares close higher with U.S. and Nokia.

text.p: Shares closed slightly higher on Friday ahead of the long midsummer weekend, boosted in late afternoon trade by U.S. economic data and by a firmer opening on Wall Street and for Nokia's ADR, brokers said.
With most domestic investors absent due to summer holidays, operators said shares would drift without clear direction until the U.S. Federal Reserve's July 1-2 policy-setting FOMC meeting.
Turnover was moderately active at 500 million markka. UPM-Kymmene eased 0.10 markka to 120.80 markka while Nokia closed 3.00 markka higher at 365.00 markka.
The market is closed on Friday and reopens on June 23.
